screening_reasoning: Proposes an LLM+RAG agent for biomedical literature QA and summarization with PubMed integration, biomedical embeddings, and benchmark evaluation including citation accuracy assessment. Directly addresses literature discovery and synthesis workflow with LLMs (INC-01, INC-02) and provides quantitative empirical evaluation (INC-04). No exclusion criteria apply.

Presents a modular human-AI collaborative framework for automating systematic literature reviews end-to-end, integrating LLMs and RAG for search string generation, screening, extraction, and report generation. Explicitly uses RAG to strengthen grounding and minimize hallucinations (INC-03), with user study evaluation showing time savings and usability metrics (INC-04). Core contribution is an AI-assisted literature review harness (INC-01, INC-02).

Develops a theoretical framework (HAIST) for human-AI collaboration in academic research with AI-assisted validation methodology. Does not propose or implement a computational tool for literature discovery, screening, extraction, or synthesis (fails INC-01). Lacks LLM/RAG integration within a scientific literature workflow (fails INC-02). No provenance, citation verification, or integrity mechanisms described (fails INC-03). No codebase or empirical evaluation of a literature harness (fails INC-04). Classified as narrative/theoretical piece lacking computational artifact for literature workflow (EXC-03).

Content analysis literature review of AI's impact on research across disciplines. Does not propose/implement a computational tool for literature workflow (fails INC-01). No LLM/RAG integration in a literature harness (fails INC-02). No provenance or integrity mechanisms (fails INC-03). Explicitly lacks primary empirical data and codebase (fails INC-04). Narrative synthesis piece without computational artifact (EXC-03).

Proposes LangGraph-based multi-agent system for BIM/IFC data analysis in construction using Gemini LLM. Not targeted to academic research or scholarly literature workflow (EXC-02). Does not address literature discovery, screening, extraction, or synthesis (fails INC-01). Uses LLMs but for BIM data analysis, not scholarly literature (fails INC-02 in context).

Introduces EvoScientist, an evolving multi-agent AI scientist framework for end-to-end scientific discovery with persistent memory (ideation and experimentation memory) enabling self-evolution. Implements specialized agents (Researcher, Engineer, Evolution Manager) with LLM orchestration (INC-01, INC-02). Memory modules provide execution provenance and strategy tracking (INC-03). Outperforms 7 SOTA systems in scientific idea generation with automatic and human evaluation benchmarks (INC-04). Directly relevant to AI research harnesses with provenance and evaluation.

Labor economics study using difference-in-differences to analyze ChatGPT's impact on freelancers in online labor markets. Not a literature review harness or scholarly literature tool (EXC-02). No computational tool for literature workflow (fails INC-01).

Clinical evaluation comparing ChatGPT vs physicians on pharmacotherapy queries. Not a literature harness; evaluates LLM for clinical decision support, not scholarly literature workflow (EXC-02). Fails all inclusion criteria.

FinATG framework for ESG financial text processing and sustainability information extraction. Targeted to financial domain, not academic research or scholarly literature (EXC-02). Uses LLMs but not for literature discovery/screening/extraction (fails INC-01, INC-02 in context).

AI risk mitigation proposal for enterprise technology consulting firm. Not scholarly literature domain (EXC-02). Narrative framework document without computational artifact for literature workflow (EXC-03). Fails all inclusion criteria.

Case study on generative AI in textile design process. Not scholarly literature domain (EXC-02). Exploratory design study without computational literature harness (EXC-03). Fails all inclusion criteria.

LLMs for open aspect-based educational summarization. Targeted to educational content summarization, not academic literature discovery/screening/extraction (EXC-02). No abstract available but venue (ACL) suggests NLP for education, not literature review harness.

Integrated business intelligence framework combining LLMs, attention mechanisms, and game-theoretic optimization for marketing, finance, and audit decisions. Not scholarly literature domain (EXC-02). Impressive empirical validation but for business intelligence, not literature harness.
Cardiology national advisory statement synthesizing ESC 2025 antiplatelet trials. Clinical practice guideline, not a computational tool (EXC-02, EXC-03). Fails all inclusion criteria.
UltraSAM3 foundation model for ultrasound image segmentation. Medical imaging domain, not scholarly literature (EXC-02). No literature workflow component.
Real-time multi-agent mobile robot system using client-server model. Robotics/control systems domain (EXC-02). Published 2023 but not relevant to literature harnesses regardless.
Hardware architecture paper on AMD MI300X AI accelerator. Not scholarly literature domain (EXC-02). No computational literature tool (EXC-03).
Multi-agent collision avoidance for UAV swarms. Robotics/AI domain, not scholarly literature (EXC-02).

Evaluates LLM agents simulating clients in counseling sessions. Uses LLMs but for counseling simulation, not academic literature workflow (EXC-02). Has evaluation framework but not for literature harness.

GazeVaLM eye-tracking benchmark for evaluating AI-generated chest X-rays. Medical imaging/benchmarking domain (EXC-02). Uses multimodal LLMs but for radiograph authenticity assessment, not literature review.
